description: This file declares an external interface IWarningReportingMedia for warning reporting functionalities within the WPEFramework. It defines a virtual destructor and a pure virtual Output method for reporting warning events, along with associated namespace organization and include directives.

classes.name: IWarningReportingMedia
classes.description: An interface for warning media reporting that declares the Output method for sending warning information, including filename, line number, identifier, and the warning event details.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: A pure virtual method intended to be implemented by subclasses to output warning information, given filename, line number, identifier, and warning event data.
